meta.title: Johan Nilsson — Operator & Investor in Premium Consumer Brands
meta.description: Johan Nilsson: twenty-five years building premium consumer brands in fitness, wellness, sport and hospitality. Barry’s in the Nordics, Iberia and Switzerland; Stockholm Leisure Partners; boards of Svensk Innebandy and AIK.

sections.label: The practice
sections.statement: The discipline of a global brand, <t>built one market at a time.</t>
body: Twenty-five years in business development, strategy and operations across fitness, wellness, sport and hospitality: strategy consulting at EY and Cordial, strategy and business development for SATS and Health & Fitness Nordic, then ten years building Barry’s in the Nordics as CEO and partner.
Today, a partner in Barry’s Iberia and Barry’s Switzerland, founding partner of Stockholm Leisure Partners, and a board member of Svensk Innebandy and AIK.

img.alt: Johan Nilsson in conversation with a studio team

sections.label: Engagements
sections.title: Where the work <t>usually begins.</t>
items: A global brand that wants to enter the Nordics, or another European market, with a partner who has done it before.
A first studio that works, and a second, third and fourth that need to work the same way.
Two operators of one brand in neighbouring countries, and the case for becoming one company.
A founder with a fitness or wellness concept, looking for capital that understands the floor as well as the spreadsheet.
A board that needs someone at the table who has carried a P&L.
A federation or club that wants its elite game run with the discipline of a commercial brand.

sections.label: The defining chapter
sections.title: Barry’s <t>in the Nordics.</t>
sections.body: A boutique fitness brand from Los Angeles, brought to Stockholm in 2016 and built studio by studio. In January 2022 the Swedish and Norwegian companies merged into the region’s largest boutique operator; the work then moved on to Spain, Switzerland and Finland.

stats.k: Studios in six Nordic cities at the merger, 2022
Markets opened since: Iberia, Switzerland, Finland

sections.src: Studio and headcount figures as reported at the 2022 merger.

items.k: The largest boutique fitness operator in the Nordics.
items.t: January 2022: Barry’s Bootcamp Nordic AB and BB Norway AS merge into one company, with eight studios in Oslo, Bergen, Sandvika, Stockholm, Gothenburg and Copenhagen.
items.d: As CEO and partner of the merged company.

items.k: Three European markets opened as partner.
items.t: Barry’s Iberia, licensed in 2022; the first Barry’s in Switzerland, Zürich, 2025; Barry’s Helsinki, 2026.
items.d: Zürich was reported as the strongest launch of any Barry’s club.

items.t: Elected to the board of Svensk Innebandy at the federation’s annual meeting in Uppsala, June 2026. Board member of AIK since March 2026.
items.d: The brief, in his words: strengthening the elite game sportingly, commercially and organisationally.

sections.lead: On joining the board of Svensk Innebandy, 2026. Translated from Swedish.
sections.q: “Looking forward to contributing to the development of Swedish floorball, and not least to strengthening the elite game sportingly, commercially and organisationally.”

steps.d: Demand, competition, sites and price points, read as an operator rather than as a consultant: what will the floor look like on a Tuesday morning?
A brand entering a country lives or dies by its local partner. The structure, the licence and the people are agreed before the site.
Site, team, product and launch, run to the brand’s standard. A first studio that opens strong carries the ones that follow.
Profitable growth, studio by studio: the standards and reporting that let a concept scale and, when the time comes, merge or sell.
